The organ that pumps blood is the heart.

Accessibility Audit:
The provided text describes a significant accessibility barrier. Presenting real-time bus and train schedules solely in a graphical format without accompanying text descriptions violates accessibility standards (such as WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 1.1.1 Non-text Content). Screen readers cannot interpret images or graphics, rendering the information completely inaccessible to users who are blind or have low vision. To improve accessibility, the schedule data should be provided in a text-based format (such as HTML tables or structured text) that screen readers can parse and vocalize. Additionally, if graphics are necessary for visual clarity, they must include appropriate alternative text (alt text) that conveys the essential information, though text-based data is preferred for dynamic content like schedules.
